NIE_PAN_HUO_ZHONG_RELIC.title: Nirvana Ember
NIE_PAN_HUO_ZHONG_RELIC.description: The first time a [gold]YuHuo[/gold] effect triggers each combat, it triggers 1 additional time.
NIE_PAN_HUO_ZHONG_RELIC.flavor: While the ember lives, the dynasty endures.
TIAN_FENG_JUN_YIN_RELIC.title: Heavenly Phoenix Seal
TIAN_FENG_JUN_YIN_RELIC.flavor: The seal falls like a mountain; orders are absolute.
QING_LUAN_YU_YI_RELIC.title: Azure Phoenix Plumage
QING_LUAN_YU_YI_RELIC.description: At the start of your turn, if you have at least {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] left after enemy attacks, gain 1 [gold]Moon[/gold].
QING_LUAN_YU_YI_RELIC.flavor: The plumage still holds its warmth.
HE_JI_WU_DIAN_RELIC.title: Tome of Convergence
HE_JI_WU_DIAN_RELIC.description: Your every [blue]{Cards}[/blue]th [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold] has its effects doubled.
ZHAN_BEI_RELIC.title: War Stele
ZHAN_BEI_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, gain {Cards:diff()} [gold]FengWei[/gold]. On your first turn, your [gold]Star-Moon Strikes[/gold] only deal damage.
ZHAN_BEI_RELIC.flavor: No names on the stele; all were heroes.
GU_WANG_YU_ZUO_RELIC.title: Lonely Throne
GU_WANG_YU_ZUO_RELIC.description: When your turn ends, if your [gold]Hand[/gold] is empty, draw {Cards:diff()} additional card and gain 1 [gold]Star-Moon Strike+[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
GU_WANG_YU_ZUO_RELIC.flavor: Upon the throne sits only one.
DI_GUO_SHUI_QI_RELIC.title: Imperial Tax Writ
DI_GUO_SHUI_QI_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 [gold]Edict[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Enemies drop additional [gold]Gold[/gold] equal to the number of [gold]Edicts[/gold] you played this combat.
DI_GUO_SHUI_QI_RELIC.flavor: The empire's favor is never free.
DI_GUO_NIAN_BIAO_RELIC.title: Imperial Chronicle
DI_GUO_NIAN_BIAO_RELIC.description: The first time you play an Attack each combat, gain 2 [gold]Star[/gold]. The first time you play a Skill each combat, gain 2 [gold]Moon[/gold].
DI_GUO_SHI_CE_RELIC.title: Imperial Annals
DI_GUO_SHI_CE_RELIC.description: The first time you play an Attack each turn, gain 1 [gold]Star[/gold]. The first time you play a Skill each turn, gain 1 [gold]Moon[/gold].
SEA_GLASS.CAN_AO.title: Ember Glass
